'''Louie Prust''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Minneapolis tournament (20 February)]] on 20 February 2001 with I don't know (possibly new-age Throne Room with DBs, mains and SA), according to Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1758">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-21-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1758/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 21 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-21-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1758/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
